evals.prompt: Our checkout API exposes `http_requests_total{code=...}`. Design a 99.9% availability SLO with Prometheus alerts.
expectations: Uses multi-window (long and short window both required)
Tells the user to confirm the metric/labels exist before shipping

evals.prompt: We get way too many pages. Here is the current list: fixtures/slo/alerts.txt. What should we change?
expectations: Moves cause alerts (CPU/restarts/disk) off paging to dashboards or tickets
Requires runbook and owner for every page
Says to measure pages before/after rather than claiming a reduction
Does not invent a percentage reduction

evals.prompt: We have a nightly data pipeline that must finish before 07:00. What SLI/SLO should we use?
expectations: Uses freshness / on-time completion as the SLI
Expresses SLI as a ratio of good to valid runs
Says to measure current performance before fixing the SLO number
